correctness.rationale: Unit ball P is the regular 12-gon with Euclidean circumradius 1, apothem c=cos(pi/12). Norm comparison gives ||z||_2<=N_12(z)<=||z||_2/c. For any unit x,y, min(N_12(x+y),N_12(x-y))<=sqrt(2)/c by parallelogram. The vertex pair v_0=(1,0), v_3=(0,1) attains it because sum/difference lie on edge-normal rays; sqrt(2)/c=2(sqrt(3)-1). Equality forces both Euclidean chords length sqrt(2), x,y length 1 and perpendicular, hence dodecagon vertices differing by 3 or 9 indices. Converse holds for every dihedral image. No missed edge-interior optimizer.
